checks.title: NaN / Inf and normalization hazards
checks.summary: 1 dim(s) whose normalization a few extreme frames dominate

findings.message: action dim 10: 49 frame(s) in 22 episode(s) (e.g. [5, 18, 20, 44, 104]) lie far outside the rest (up to -6.278; 98% of frames within [-0.1224, 0.1177]) and inflate the std 6.8x (0.2778 vs 0.04108 without them) - mean/std normalization squashes every other frame. Glitch frames, or a different robot/unit mixed in: drop or fix those episodes, or normalize by quantiles
